FUS-1 SHIPPED fusion (the first of this backlog) and returned a finding the backlog must carry: a live capture can overturn a terminal verdict AND correct the seed's IDENTITY — 'fusion' is the vendor spreadsheet by name, but the click target resolves to the projects-and-files browser, so the port serves the grammar the target actually expresses. Read each remaining candidate's LIVE state before assuming its seed name names its app. MAP-1 SHIPPED map (the second of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: adjudicate the PLANE before the pixels. A canvas-grammar seed can be fully live-evidenced AND still have no honest rendering behind it — the answer is to port the landing grammar and make the un-renderable region a typed absence that distinguishes MISSING from the reference's own EMPTY, never to draw a plausible picture and never to downgrade the seed back to absent. REG-1 SHIPPED registry (the third of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: when the estate DOES have the plane, the honest work is DISCRIMINATION rather than absence. Probe each lane's plane over the surface's own identity and classify from the response itself — a typed refusal, an empty collection and a plane with no read route are three different truths and NONE of them is a zero. Rendering an identity-first refusal as “0 records” is the same defect class as drawing a plausible map: it converts a closed door into a measurement the estate never took. JOB-1 SHIPPED jobs (the fourth of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: when several planes project the SAME records, the work is not picking the biggest one but asking which projection is COMPLETE and which fields each one carries. Here two projections of one plane were each incomplete AND each missing a field the other had (the transcript plane: a state_root on every record and a principal on none; the per-automation projection: a principal, no state root, and no reach at all to executions whose automation was deleted) — and the union plane that carried both had to be found before a single row could be rendered honestly. Re-derive the reach counts on every render so the plane choice can never rot into a stale justification, and LINK a plane that another surface already renders rather than minting a second renderer over the same records. SCH-1 SHIPPED scheduler (the fifth of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: a number is not a measurement until you know the PREDICATE that produced it and the WINDOW it covers, and the field that carries the concept's NAME is routinely not the one the runtime acts on. Here the scheduler loop admits on `enabled && schedule_is_active(schedule_spec)` and never reads `trigger`, so the automation it fires on a cron reads trigger_kind: manual and a trigger-shaped view would have reported zero schedules while the loop fired one; a second projection of the same census admits by a different predicate again (it never reads `enabled`); and two of the three counters the surface would naturally put in its header are reset every tick, so printing them as totals would convert a 15-second window into a history exactly as printing a refusal as 0 converts a closed door into a measurement. Read a field's DEFINITION from the code or route that WRITES it, never from its name, print the predicate and the window beside every number, and where another component owns a predicate, link its own count rather than re-deriving the test in a read surface — a re-implemented admission rule is a second answer waiting to disagree with the first. ING-1 SHIPPED ingest (the sixth of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: A SELF-REPORT IS SCOPED TO THE RECORD THAT CARRIES IT, NEVER TO THE ESTATE — so join on the keys the records carry before you believe any field, including the one that sounds like a system state. Here the estate had the WHOLE chain (source → mapping → policy view → transform → projection → lease → run → session → objects) with real records at every stage, so the leg was neither MAP-1's 'is there anything' nor only REG-1's 'which state is this plane in': it was WHICH RECORD DO YOU BELIEVE. Five fields disagreed with what the chain demonstrably did. A source whose rows were fetched under a receipted HTTP 200 still reads ingestion.wired:false, because that flag is written ONCE at declaration time and no run revises it — read a field's WRITE path, and also ask WHEN it was written, because a declaration-time constant that never updates looks exactly like a live state until you join it. A mapping reads health.status:'ready' while the same object reports object_instances:0 and its own note says it extracts nothing: 'ready' is a verdict on the DECLARATION's well-formedness, not on the run, so the port renders it under a header reading 'Declared state' and never one reading 'Status'. The plane's roll-up states as an UNQUALIFIED whole-plane claim that nothing here moves source data, in an estate holding extracted rows that arrived through the lane beside it — true of a mapping, false of the estate, which is the same defect class as a refusal printed as a zero. missing_contracts names contracts that already EXIST for that very mapping, because it is computed without reading downstream at all. And a connector session reports data_moved:false about the crossing its own object set names it as the provenance of — two planes, one event, opposite answers: NAME the contradiction rather than adjudicate it, because picking the record that agrees with your column header is the surface deciding a question the estate never answered. Practically: derive every count from the OUTPUT records (the only ones carrying a verbatim receipt), light a UI element because a JOIN found a record and never because a status field said so, state what the join COSTS when the estate keys a stage on a different noun (a materializing run is keyed on the SOURCE, not the pipeline, so two pipelines over one source would be unattributable — say so instead of guessing), and render a reference that points at a sibling application by LINKING that application when the estate actually has it: the one control HyperAuto offered that this estate could honour exactly was its own empty-state link. MS-1 SHIPPED modelstudio (the seventh of this backlog) and returned the finding the remaining legs must carry: A VERB WHOSE ROUTE EXISTS IS STILL A GAP WHEN THE FORM'S FIELDS AND THE ROUTE'S REQUIRED FIELDS DO NOT INTERSECT. The seed's live root is not a canvas and not a list but a CREATION-ENTRY DIALOG ('Choose file location': a pre-filled File name, a Location folder dropdown, Browse/Cancel/Save) over a tenant holding zero files — so the dialog IS the landing grammar, and the port's question was not MAP-1's 'is there anything', nor REG-1's 'which state is this plane in', nor ING-1's 'which record do you believe', but WHETHER THE VERB THE REFERENCE DRAWS IS THE VERB THE ROUTE ENFORCES. The estate publishes POST /v1/hypervisor/foundry/specs — real, durable, unauthenticated at this posture — so every surface-level test for 'is there a governed lane behind this button' said yes, and wiring Save on that basis would have been defensible in review and wrong in the receipt. Read the write path, not the route list: the record it creates carries NO location field of any kind (the one thing the dialog is NAMED for would be silently dropped), and its admission test demands a resolving model-route or provider binding the dialog offers no control for (so a wired Save would have had to CHOOSE that binding for the person, and the receipt would then record a decision nobody made). CHECK THE EDGE FROM BOTH SIDES and re-derive it every render: 0 of 11 project records carry any spec/foundry field, none of the 3 published project write routes would accept one, and 0 of 18 Foundry routes name a location concept — so the containment relation is MISSING, not unpopulated, and it is rendered beside an EMPTY spec plane on the same page so the reader cannot mistake the zero for one save away. Two further transfers: (a) a value DERIVED AT OPEN is not a record — the two recorded reference states are byte-identical except the pre-filled name's timestamp, which is the whole proof that the vendor computes it at dialog-open, so the port derives it at render, says it is stored nowhere, and the gate proves the derivation by fetching the page twice a second apart rather than pinning the string; (b) SCH-1's predicate rule applies to AFFORDANCES, not only to numbers — the reference's green validity check is kept but its predicate is named as well-formedness and the availability reading is explicitly refused, because no plane indexes names inside a location and a check mark that silently means 'valid' where the reader reads 'available' is a decorative assertion with a UI shape. Practically: name the route BY PATH inside the typed absence so a reader can check the refusal instead of trusting it, gap-mark the ACT and not the records when the list is real and only the edge is missing, and deliver the family link in the same cut. INF-1 SHIPPED inference (the eighth and LAST of this backlog, which it CLOSES) and returned the finding the estate must carry forward: A SELECTION THE ROUTE ACCEPTS IS STILL A GAP WHEN THE KEY IT FILTERS ON IS NEVER WRITTEN BY THE RECORDS IT IS MEANT TO SCOPE. The seed's live root is neither a wizard nor a list but a SPACE GATE — one heading, "Please select a space", over one control, "Select a space…", rows 0, no space picked — so the gate IS the landing grammar, and the port's question was the next one after MS-1's. MS-1 asked whether the verb the form draws is the verb the route enforces; here the RECEIVING SIDE IS FINE and the defect is one layer further in. Exactly two published reads in the whole daemon index accept a project as a query filter, and the work ledger both accepts and APPLIES one — read from the write path, it retains only entries whose project_id equals the selection — so every surface-level test for 'can this chooser be wired' says yes, INCLUDING MS-1's field-intersection test, because the parameter the form collects IS a parameter the route enforces. It is still a gap: of 7141 ledger entries, 60 carry that key and 542 name a model, and the intersection is ZERO. A wired chooser would have dropped every invocation the estate ever recorded and printed the loss as an empty space. ASK THE OWNER OF A PREDICATE RATHER THAN RE-IMPLEMENTING IT (SCH-1, carried onto a filter): the page puts three principled selections to the daemon on every render — the first space the plane offers, the first space value the ledger's own rows carry that resolves to a real space, and the space key the inference lane itself writes — and prints the daemon's own answers (0 · 34-of-which-0 · 0) rather than re-deriving the retain expression in a read surface. WHY THIS IS WORSE THAN A MISSING ROUTE: a missing chooser is legible — the reader sees the estate cannot answer. A chooser wired to an unwritten key is illegible: it renders, it accepts, it filters, and it returns a confident zero indistinguishable from a genuinely empty space, which the first of the three asks demonstrates exactly (a real space with no rows and a real space whose rows lack the key both answer 0). That is REG-1's 'a refusal is never a zero' carried onto an AFFORDANCE: an unanswerable question rendered as an answer. CHECK EVERY VOCABULARY, NOT JUST EVERY DIRECTION: the plane that DOES carry a space key — the goal-run lane, 190 records fanning into 348 declared invocation refs — pins project_ref to ONE value that resolves to NO space record, so three planes that would have to agree on what a space is share no vocabulary at all. A key that exists and dangles is the same defect class as a key that is never written, and both look like working joins from the route list. And the edge was checked from the other side and re-derived every render: 0 of 11 space records carry an invocation field, 0 of their 25 refs names an invocation or a model route, 0 of 3 project write routes would accept one, 0 of 47 readable invocation receipts and 0 of 10 metered usage records carry a space field, and 0 of the invoke verb's 6 accepted body fields names a space. FINALLY, EVIDENCE HYGIENE: the capture caught a PLATFORM news dialog floating over the app plus a rail entry naming the LAST-VISITED application, and either read as app IA would have ported the wrong thing — the news dialog as a feature, or the wrong application entirely. Junk evidence is NAMED in the surface with data-ioi-control-evidence="excluded_junk" so the exclusion can be checked rather than discovered as a silent omission; of 12 recorded controls, nine are vendor rail, two are the dialog's, and ONE is the app's. The recorded URL is the authority on identity; the rail is not. BACKLOG CLOSED (INF-1, 2026-08-20). Eight legs, eight findings, each one the next question after the last: FUS-1 — read the LIVE state before assuming the seed name names its app (identity). MAP-1 — adjudicate the PLANE before the pixels; typed absence distinguishes MISSING from the reference's own EMPTY (is there anything). REG-1 — DISCRIMINATE: a typed refusal, an empty collection and a plane with no read route are three truths and none is a zero (what state is the plane in). JOB-1 — find the COMPLETE projection or the honest union, link what another surface already renders, and re-derive the reach counts every render (which projection). SCH-1 — every number needs its PREDICATE and its WINDOW, and a field's definition comes from its WRITE path, never its name (what does the number mean). ING-1 — a self-report is scoped to its record, so JOIN on the keys the records carry and NAME contradictions rather than adjudicating them (which record do you believe). MS-1 — a published route is not a wired verb; check the edge from BOTH sides and prove derivations by fetching twice (is the verb the route enforces the verb the form draws). INF-1 — a selection the route accepts is not a working filter; the key it lands on has to be written by the records it scopes, and a key that dangles is the same defect as a key that is never written (is the affordance's answer real). Read end to end the chain is one rule getting sharper: EVERY LAYER OF AN AFFORDANCE CAN CHECK OUT AND THE ANSWER STILL BE MANUFACTURED, so the last question is always asked of the RECORDS, not of the route list, the field name, the status flag or the parameter.
